_comment: The labeled set TriageEvaluation scores prompt variants against. Rows are the shape the classifier sees (sender, subject, one preview line — never a body) with the expected priority (spam | low | medium | high) and expected label names from `labels`. These rows are generic placeholders; replace them with your own anonymised mail (change names, amounts and companies, keep the shape) — a dozen per priority is enough to tell two prompts apart.
